latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of Crypto Content Crafter.

- Instantly generates all core NFT/crypto collection marketing content from a single product name and details.
- Produces collection descriptions, short pitches, Twitter threads, Discord welcomes, roadmaps, and tokenomics blurbs.
- Uses reference templates for consistent, high-quality output.
- Supports both command-line input and interactive prompting for data collection.
- Designed to tailor all content toward web3 audiences and community growth.
